title: TypeScript
summary: Only the TypeScript that React and Node.js work needs: everyday types, typed components and API data, and TypeScript on Node.js.

pace.effort: alongside the React and Node.js tracks

skip.why: advanced type tricks; learn them when a codebase needs them
Node.js runs TypeScript by stripping types, which only works with erasable syntax

modules.title: Everyday types
modules.goal: Read and write the types you meet every day, and convert a small JavaScript app to TypeScript.
learn: Types, interfaces, union and literal types
Adding types to props, state and API responses
Narrowing, and how to read generics

build.title: Convert an app to TypeScript
checklist: Convert a small JavaScript app to TypeScript and ship it through a GitHub pull request
Convert a React app you have built to TypeScript

notNow: Advanced type tricks such as conditional and mapped types
modules.source: JavaScript-80-20-Roadmap · Week 7 + Full-Stack Developer 80 20 Roadmap · Week 2

modules.title: TypeScript for React
modules.goal: Type props, state, events, refs, context and API responses in a React app.
learn: Only the TypeScript React needs: type vs interface, unions ('idle' | 'loading' | 'error'), optional fields, arrays, and enough generics to read useState<User | null>(null).
Type props (with children: React.ReactNode), events (React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>), refs (useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)), context and API responses.
Extend native elements: type ButtonProps = React.ComponentProps<'button'> & { variant: 'primary' | 'ghost' }.
Model UI states with discriminated unions so "loading and error at once" can't happen.

build.title: Typed expense tracker
build.brief: Migrate the React track’s Week 2 expense tracker to TypeScript with strict mode on.

doneWhen: tsc passes in strict mode with zero any

modules.title: TypeScript on Node.js
modules.goal: Run a typed Express API with Node’s built-in type stripping and keep tsc as the type checker.
learn: TypeScript: types, interfaces, unions, basic generics, strict mode, typing Express handlers, z.infer to reuse Zod schemas as types

build.title: Typed API
checklist: Convert the project to TypeScript with strict: true; run it with Node's built-in type stripping, and add tsc --noEmit to npm test (set erasableSyntaxOnly in tsconfig, so skip enum and namespace)
